import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNextInt()) {
            int n = scanner.nextInt();
            List<Integer> a = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                int x = scanner.nextInt();
                a.add(x);
            }
            Collections.sort(a);
            System.out.println(a.get(n / 2));
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
